name: Appointment Letter
css:
APPOINTMENT LETTER

Dear Employee, We are pleased to appoint you as Manager with our organization. Your employment shall commence from the date specified in your employment records and shall be governed by the Company's policies and procedures. The terms and conditions of your employment are as follows:
Term Details
Position Manager
Probation Period 6 Months
Working Hours As per Company Policy
Salary & Benefits As per Employment Contract and Company Policy
Leave Entitlement As per Company Policy and Applicable Labour Laws
Confidentiality All Company information shall be treated as confidential.
Termination As per Company Policy and Applicable Labour Laws.

You will be responsible for managing operations, supervising staff, ensuring policy compliance, and contributing to the achievement of organizational goals.

We welcome you to the organization and wish you a successful and rewarding career with us.



For and on behalf of the Company




_____________________________
Authorized Signatory



Employee Acceptance

I hereby accept the appointment and agree to abide by the terms and conditions of employment stated above.



_____________________________
Employee Signature

name: Resignation Letter
html:
Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.nowdate()) }}
To,
{{ doc.reports_to_name or "The Reporting Manager" }}
{% set company = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", doc.employee, "company") %} {{ company or "" }}
Subject: Resignation from the position of {{ doc.designation or "" }}
Dear Sir/Madam,
I, {{ doc.employee_name }} (Employee ID: {{ doc.employee }}), currently working as {{ doc.designation or "" }} in the {{ doc.department or "" }} department, hereby tender my resignation from {{ company or "the organisation" }}, effective from my last working day mentioned below.
Date of Joining: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.date_of_joining) if doc.date_of_joining else "-" }}
Notice Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.notice_date) if doc.notice_date else "-" }}
Proposed Last Working Day: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.last_working_day) if doc.last_working_day else "-" }}
Notice Period: {% if doc.notice_date and doc.last_working_day %}{{ frappe.utils.date_diff(doc.last_working_day, doc.notice_date) }} day(s){% else %}-{% endif %}
{% if doc.exit_reason %}
Reason for resignation: {{ doc.exit_reason }}
{% endif %}
I request you to kindly relieve me on or before the last working day mentioned above and help complete the necessary formalities. I am committed to ensuring a smooth handover of my responsibilities during the notice period.
Thank you for the opportunity to work at {{ company or "the organisation" }}.
Sincerely,
 
Employee Signature
Name: {{ doc.employee_name }}
Employee ID: {{ doc.employee }}
Date: ____________________
This letter was generated by the system from your resignation request details. Please download, sign it (physically or digitally), and upload the signed copy back to this page to complete your submission.
